properties.name: Diakon Solutions
properties.description:
Diakon Solutions LLC has over 26 years of multi-disciplined experience in helping businesses and organizations achieve their goals through our technology development and support services.

Diakon Solutions’ services include all aspects of Information Technology (IT), Research & Development (R&D), Development and Application of New and Advanced Technologies, Facility Operation and Management, and Project Management of such activities.

Diakon Solutions can not only assist your organization with carrying out the tasks necessary to meet your objectives, but we can also assist you with determining the tasks, processes, technologies and procedures that are necessary in order to meet your objectives based on analysis of your requirements. We help you get there from here.

The Diakon Solutions staff has been providing continuous direct support to the FAA for over 20 years with a proven track record of professionalism, reliability, responsibility, competence, technical and management experience and performance, honesty, loyalty and impeccable customer satisfaction. This experience has been as both contractor and federal employee. For over 12 years we have also been serving non-government businesses and organizations with our Information Technology (IT) Support Services.

It is the mission and goal of Diakon Solutions to fully embrace your technology-related goals and objectives as our own and to ensure that they are realized with excellence.
